import urllib.request as ur
import urllib.error as ue
candidates = [
    'http://retinal-functomics.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/BadenEtAl_RGCs_2016_v1.mat',
    'http://retinal-functomics.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/BadenEtAl_RGCs_2016_v1.mat',
    'http://retinal-functomics.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/BadenEtAl_RGCs_2016_v1.mat',
    'http://retinal-functomics.net/data/BadenEtAl_RGCs_2016_v1.mat',
    'http://retinal-functomics.net/data/Baden_et_al_2016/BadenEtAl_RGCs_2016_v1.mat',
    'https://retinal-functomics.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/BadenEtAl_RGCs_2016_v1.mat',
    'https://retinal-functomics.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/BadenEtAl_RGCs_2016_v1.mat',
    'https://retinal-functomics.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/BadenEtAl_RGCs_2016_v1.mat',
    'https://retinal-functomics.net/data/BadenEtAl_RGCs_2016_v1.mat',
]
for url in candidates:
    req = ur.Request(url, method='HEAD', headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; research-script/1.0)'})
    try:
        with ur.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as r:
            print(f'{r.status} {url} (size={r.headers.get("Content-Length")})')
    except ue.HTTPError as e:
        print(f'{e.code} {url}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'ERR {url}: {type(e).__name__}: {e}')
